motion_texts.string: That the Community and Protective Services Committee convene In Closed Session for the purpose of considering the following:

transcript: Good afternoon, everyone. I would like to call to order the fifth meeting or the fifth special meeting, sorry, of the Community and Protective Services Committee. I'll start with the land acknowledgement. The city of London is situated on the traditional lands of the Anishinaabic. Haudenosaunee, Lenapawik and Adewandran, we honor and respect the history, languages, and culture of the diverse indigenous people who call this territory home. The city of London is currently home to many First Nation, Métis, and Inuit today. As representatives of the people of the city of London, we are grateful to have the opportunity to work and live in this territory. I am joined by all members of committee, including Mayor Morgan, and I have no other Councillors online at this time. I'll move to item one, oh, sorry, I should mention, the city of London is committed to making every effort to provide alternate formats and communication support for meetings upon request to make a request specific to this meeting, please contact CPSC at London.ca or five, one, nine, six, six, one, two, four, eight, nine, extension, two, four, two, five. With that, we'll move on to item one, disclosures of peuniary interest. Okay, seeing none, we have no items for consent, scheduled items, items for direction, or deferred matters additional business. With that, we'll move to item six, which is our confidential item. As stated in the agenda, I'll look for a mover and a seconder. Councillor Hopkins, Councillor Ferrera, thank you. We will open that in just a moment. Closing the vote, the motion carries six to zero. Thank you, just a moment to prepare the room. recording in progress.
